title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：peace　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 peace 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the clerk ① kept the peace that no applicant in the office would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the month. The ② peace, meaning the calm itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; peace, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of peace in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ peace at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Peace, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the peace was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the calm. The ⑥ peace, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; peace, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both calm and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ peace had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ peace of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of recording; peace, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ peace I remember is the peace recorded in the file, which closed in 1969 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Peace, my mother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all peace, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like calm. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 和平；安宁（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 和平；安宁（指那份和平本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the peace 守护这一份和平
D. n. 和平；安宁（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 和平之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的和平之事）
F. n. 和平；安宁（指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一份）
G. n. 和平、盼望（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 盼望（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the peace that no applicant in the office would have recorded
The peace, meaning the calm itself and not the stamp
Every sort of peace in that office
the peace at the far counter
the peace was the whole of the matter
the peace had become a line in a file
The peace of the whole thing

answers.why: keep the peace 意为“守护这一份和平”，1962 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一份和平做了一遍。
peace 意为“和平；安宁”，指那份和平本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
peace 意为“和平；安宁”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
peace 意为“和平；安宁”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
peace 意为“和平、盼望”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份盼望就是那件事的全部。
peace 意为“盼望”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份和平，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
peace 意为“和平；安宁”，指卷宗里写到、被记载的那一份，到 1967 年这一份成了卷宗里的一行。
peace 意为“和平之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的和平之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记载。
peace 意为“和平；安宁”，我记得的是卷宗里记载过的那一份，1969 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一份。
peace 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，和平是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的和平。

items: 1962 年那位书记员守护了办事处里没有一位申请人肯记载的一份和平，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（keep the peace）
那份和平，指的是那份和平本身而不是小小的印章，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。（peace）
那处办事处里每一类和平旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。（peace）
最远那个窗口那份和平，指的是他们留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（peace）
叔叔说这份盼望就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那份和平。（peace）
1971 年母亲说，和平是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的和平。（peace）

Every sort of peace in that office had the same short stamp beside it.
The peace at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the peace was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the calm.
